cohort: 112 pregnant women with epilepsy and 277 pregnant women without epilepsy
finding: Pregnant women with epilepsy were at increased risk for pregnancy and delivery complications, including preterm delivery, cesarean section, fetal hypoxia, and low Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly more common in women with epilepsy and was associated with an increased risk of perinatal hypoxia in their offspring.
